title: Prepare and publish SpecSync 5.1.0 with accurate release metadata and current competitive documentation
description: Prepare and publish SpecSync 5.1.0 with accurate release metadata and current competitive documentation
no_spec_change_rationale: The release packages already accepted canonical behavior; this change updates version, changelog, release workflow metadata, archives integrated evidence, and public comparison documentation without changing runtime contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Cargo package and lock metadata report version 5.1.0 while historical references remain unchanged
CHANGELOG.md contains a dated 5.1.0 section and release link that accurately summarizes accepted changes
The Trust workflow validates with SpecSync 5.1.0
Comparison documentation reflects current Spec Kit 0.12.15, OpenSpec 1.6.0, and BMAD 6.10.0 capabilities without claiming feature parity
All integrated accepted changes are archived and no stale active lifecycle records remain
Strict specs, complete tests, release build, documentation checks, hosted CI, Trust, and provenance verification pass before tagging v5.1.0
